content.title: SeeMe in Brighton!
content.summary: Dr. Michael Moneypenny and Dr. Selina Hasan from our team attended the Association for Simulated Practice in Healthcare's (ASPiH) 14th national conference held in Brighton.

content.text: Dr. Michael Moneypenny and Dr. Selina Hasan from our team attended the Association for Simulated Practice in Healthcare's (ASPiH) 14th national conference held in Brighton.

Dr. Moneypenny, the immediate past president of ASPiH and member of the standards working group, played a pivotal role in the launch of the 2023 ASPiH standards for simulated practice. His invaluable insights and dedication to setting high standards in simulated healthcare practices continue to shape the landscape of healthcare education.

Meanwhile, Dr. Selina Hasan actively engaged in a series of captivating workshops that were an integral part of the conference. Her participation highlighted her commitment to staying at the forefront of cutting-edge techniques and methodologies in healthcare simulation, further enriching our team's expertise.

The conference served as a dynamic platform for knowledge exchange, innovation, and collaboration among healthcare simulation professionals. The CIME team's contributions at the ASPiH conference exemplify our unwavering dedication to excellence in healthcare education and underscore our commitment to continually pushing the boundaries of simulated practice for the betterment of healthcare professionals and, ultimately, patient care.
